correctness.rationale: The 15 vertices of L(KG(5,2)) and its 30 edges were reconstructed independently from disjoint Petersen 2-subsets. At r=3, the odd-threshold ball witness lemma yields the 30 distinct sets N[u]∪N[v] of cardinality seven. Direct independent enumerator found 2140 nonempty faces and f=(15,105,430,765,585,210,30). An independently coded free-face critical-facet algorithm produced 1059 pairs and critical vector one 0-cell plus 21 3-cells; oriented all 8955 Hasse incidences and topologically sorted the full graph. Forman then gives an integral wedge of 21 S^3, not just a mod-two homology claim. Pure 6-dimensional and H_3 nonzero gives non-shellability. The inspected verify.py additionally checks all 32768 ball-witness masks, reverse tie order and mod-two boundary ranks (14,91,339,405,180,30), not re-executed in this audit.

value.rationale: The line graph of the Petersen graph is a canonical small highly symmetric four-regular graph, not an arbitrary enumerative slice. Its first odd Čech scale beyond the known scale-two collapse exhibits a complete integral homotopy type with a six-to-three dimension drop and non-shellability. This gives an exact reproducible benchmark for graph metric topology; no family theorem is needed.
